source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: صبح يوم، لقينا عصفور صغير وقع من عشه.
sentences.en: One morning, we found a little bird that had fallen from its nest.
It was scared and its wing was hurt.

sentences.ar: أخذناه عالبيت وحطيناه بعلبة فيها قطن.
sentences.en: We took it home and put it in a box with cotton.

sentences.ar: أطعمناه فتات خبز وحطينا جنبه مي.
sentences.en: We fed it bread crumbs and put water next to it.

sentences.ar: كل يوم، كنا نهتم فيه ونتفرج عليه.
sentences.en: Every day, we took care of it and watched it.
After a week, its wing started to heal.
It started hopping in the box and trying to fly.
One day, we opened the window and held it out on our hand.

sentences.ar: طار العصفور بالسما ونحنا عم نتفرج.
sentences.en: The bird flew into the sky while we watched.

sentences.ar: زعلنا إنه راح، بس فرحنا إنه صار حر.
sentences.en: We were sad it left, but happy it became free.
